camel_example: aliyun ossutil api put-object --bucket examplebucket --key exampledir/exampleobject/txt --region cn-hangzhou
name: PutObject

parameters.help_en: The full path of the object
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to overwrite an existing object with the same name in a PutObject operation. When the destination bucket is in the enabled or suspended versioning state, the x-oss-forbid-overwrite request header is invalid, and existing objects with the same name can be overwritten.
If you do not specify x-oss-forbid-overwrite or set x-oss-forbid-overwrite to false, an existing object with the same name can be overwritten.
If you set x-oss-forbid-overwrite to true, an existing object with the same name cannot be overwritten.

Setting the x-oss-forbid-overwrite request header decreases the QPS processing performance. If you need to use the x-oss-forbid-overwrite request header in a large number of operations (QPS > 1000), contact technical support to avoid impact on your business.
Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
指定PutObject操作时是否覆盖同名Object。 当目标Bucket处于已开启或已暂停的版本控制状态时，x-oss-forbid-overwrite请求Header设置无效，即允许覆盖同名Object。
不指定x-oss-forbid-overwrite或者指定x-oss-forbid-overwrite为false时，表示允许覆盖同名Object。
指定x-oss-forbid-overwrite为true时，表示禁止覆盖同名Object。

设置x-oss-forbid-overwrite请求Header会导致QPS处理性能下降，如果您有大量的操作需要使用x-oss-forbid-overwrite请求Header（QPS>1000），请联系技术支持，避免影响您的业务。
默认值：false
parameters.name: x_oss_forbid_overwrite

parameters.help_en:
The server-side encryption method that is used when the object is created.

Valid values: AES256, KMS, or SM4

If you specify this header, it is returned in the response header, and OSS encrypts the uploaded object. When you download the object, the response header contains x-oss-server-side-encryption, and the value is set to the encryption algorithm of the object
parameters.help_zh:
创建Object时，指定服务器端加密方式。

取值：AES256、KMS****或SM4****

指定此选项后，在响应头中会返回此选项，OSS会对上传的Object进行加密编码存储。当下载该Object时，响应头中会包含x-oss-server-side-encryption，且该值会被设置成此Object的加密算法
parameters.name: x_oss_server_side_encryption

parameters.help_en:
The server-side encryption method that is used when the object is created.

Valid values: AES256, KMS, or SM4

If you specify this option, it is returned in the response header, and OSS encrypts and encodes the uploaded object for storage. When you download the object, the response header contains x-oss-server-side-encryption, and the value is settings to the encryption algorithm of the object
parameters.help_zh:
创建Object时，指定服务器端加密方式。

取值：AES256、KMS或SM4

指定此选项后，在响应头中会返回此选项，OSS会对上传的Object进行加密编码存储。当下载该Object时，响应头中会包含x-oss-server-side-encryption，且该值会被设置成此Object的加密算法
parameters.name: x_oss_server_side_data_encryption

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the customer master key (CMK) hosted in Key Management Service (KMS).
This parameter is valid only when x-oss-server-side-encryption is set to KMS
parameters.help_zh:
KMS托管的用户主密钥。
此选项仅在x-oss-server-side-encryption为KMS时有效
parameters.name: x_oss_server_side_encryption_key_id

parameters.help_en:
The access control list (ACL) of the object when it is created.

Valid values:

default: The object inherits the ACL of the bucket.
private: The object is a private resource. Only the object owner and authorized users have read and access permissions on the object. Other users do not have permissions to perform operations on the object.
public-read: The object is a public-read resource. Only the object owner and authorized users have read and access permissions on the object. Other users have only read permissions on the object. Exercise caution when you set this value.
public-read-write: The object is a public-read-write resource. All users have read and access permissions on the object. Exercise caution when you set this value.

For more information about ACLs, see **https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100676.html**
parameters.help_zh:
指定OSS创建Object时的访问权限。

取值：

default（默认）：Object遵循所在存储空间的访问权限。
private：Object是私有资源。只有Object的拥有者和授权用户有该Object的读写权限，其他用户没有权限操作该Object。
public-read：Object是公共读资源。只有Object的拥有者和授权用户有该Object的读写权限，其他用户只有该Object的读权限。请谨慎使用该权限。
public-read-write：Object是公共读写资源。所有用户都有该Object的读写权限。请谨慎使用该权限。

关于访问权限的更多信息，请参见**https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100676.html**
parameters.name: x_oss_object_acl

parameters.help_en:
The storage class of the object. For a bucket of any storage class, if you specify this parameter when you upload an object, the object is stored as the specified storage class. For example, if you specify x-oss-storage-class as Standard when you upload an object to an IA bucket, the object is stored as Standard.

Valid values:

Standard
IA: Infrequent Access
Archive
ColdArchive: Cold Archive

For more information about storage classes, see Overview of storage classes
parameters.help_zh: 指定Object的存储类型。                               对于任意存储类型的Bucket，如果上传Object时指定此参数，则此次上传的Object将存储为指定的类型。例如在IA类型的Bucket中上传Object时，如果指定x-oss-storage-class为Standard，则该Object直接存储为Standard。                              取值：                                 Standard：标准存储                                    IA：低频访问                                    Archive：归档存储                                    ColdArchive：冷归档存储                                    关于存储类型的更多信息，请参见存储类型介绍
parameters.name: x_oss_storage_class

parameters.help_en:
The tag of the object. You can set multiple tags at the same time, for example, TagA=A&TagB=B.
The key and value must be URL-encoded. If a tag does not contain an equal sign (=), the tag value is considered an empty string
parameters.help_zh:
指定Object的标签，可同时设置多个标签，例如TagA=A&TagB=B。
Key和Value需要先进行URL编码，如果某项没有”=“，则看作Value为空字符串
parameters.name: x_oss_tagging

parameters.help_en:
When you call the PutObject operation, if a parameter is prefixed with **x-oss-meta-*, the parameter is considered as user metadata, such as `x-oss-meta-location`. An object can have multiple user metadata parameters. However, the total size of all user metadata cannot exceed 8 KB.

User metadata supports hyphens (-), digits, and lowercase letters (a to z). Uppercase letters are converted to lowercase letters. Other characters such as underscores (_) are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
使用PutObject接口时，如果配置以**x-oss-meta-*为前缀的参数，则该参数视为元数据，例如`x-oss-meta-location`。一个Object可以有多个类似的参数，但所有的元数据总大小不能超过8 KB。

元数据支持短划线（-）、数字、英文字母（a~z）。英文字符的大写字母会被转成小写字母，不支持下划线（_）在内的其他字符
parameters.name: x_oss_meta_*
